lessons.title: Suggested project ladder
items: Beginner — Responsive personal portfolio with semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, accessibility and deployment.
Frontend — React task manager with routing, forms, validation, API calls, loading/error states and tests.
Backend — Express REST API with TypeScript, JWT authentication, role permissions, validation and PostgreSQL.
Java backend — Spring Boot inventory or billing API with JPA, MySQL/PostgreSQL, validation, security and tests.
Full stack — React + Spring Boot or React + Node application with authentication, dashboards, CRUD, search and file uploads.
NoSQL — MongoDB-backed catalog or booking service with aggregation, indexes and pagination.
AI — RAG-based document assistant with citations, access controls, evaluation and usage limits.
Cloud/DevOps — Containerize a full-stack app, add GitHub Actions CI/CD, deploy to AWS, configure monitoring and backups.
E-commerce — Shopify theme customization or integration using Liquid, Storefront API/GraphQL and webhooks.

lessons.title: Final Skills Checklist
items: I can build a responsive, accessible frontend without copying a template blindly.
I understand JavaScript asynchronous behavior and can debug browser issues.
I can build React components, forms, routes and data-fetching flows.
I can design and implement a secure REST API.
I can use Node/Express and Java/Spring Boot for backend services.
I can model relational and document databases and write efficient queries.
I can write tests and use Git branches and pull requests.
I can containerize an application and explain its deployment.
I can deploy and monitor an application in a cloud environment such as AWS.
I can integrate an AI model responsibly and evaluate its output.
I can explain the architecture, trade-offs, security and deployment of my projects.
